strap.definition:
n. an elongated leather strip (or a strip of similar material) for binding things together or holding something in position
n. hanger consisting of a loop of leather suspended from the ceiling of a bus or train; passengers hold onto it
n. a band that goes over the shoulder and supports a garment or bag
n. whip consisting of a strip of leather used in flogging
strap.translation:
n. 带, 皮带
vt. (用皮带)捆扎

strap-hanger.translation: n. 在公共汽车上拉着吊环站立的人；乘车上下班的人

strap-hangers.translation: (strap-hanger 的复数) n. 在公共汽车上拉着吊环站立的人；乘车上下班的人

strap-laid.translation: a. 用两条三股绳平列缝合的

strapasse.translation: [法](绘画或雕塑形象)被歪曲、夸张了的

straphanger.definition:
n. a commuter who uses public transportation
n. a standing subway or bus passenger who grips a hanging strap for support
straphanger.translation: n. (乘车时)拉着吊环站立的人

strapless.definition:
n. a woman's garment that exposes the shoulders and has no shoulder straps
s. having no straps
strapless.translation: a. 无带的, 无背带的

straplike.definition: s long and narrow like a strap

strapontin.translation: n. (汽车或剧院等中可翻起的)折叠式加座

strappado.definition: n. a form of torture in which the hands are tied behind a person's back and they are lifted off the ground by a rope tied to their wrists, then allowed to drop until their fall is checked with a jerk by the rope
strappado.translation: n. 吊刑, 处以吊刑

strappadoes.translation: n. 吊刑, 处以吊刑( strappado的名词复数 )

strapped.definition:
v tie with a strap
v beat severely with a whip or rod
v sharpen with a strap
v secure (a sprained joint) with a strap
strapped.translation: a. 用皮绳捆住的, 用皮带装饰的, 身无分文的

strapper.definition: n a large and strong and heavyset man
strapper.translation: n. 包扎工(机), 彪形大汉

strapping.definition:
